svg.text: BMT CAN logger - ESP32-S3 + TJA1051T/3 (listen-only) + GNSS + DHT22 + fan + A7670C (optional)
Generated by hardware/gen_schematic.py - do not edit by hand. Parts marked FLEET are left off the test device.
POWER: switched 12 V from an ACC fuse tap with an inline 3 A blade fuse. OBD-II pin 16 is NEVER connected (fleet 01-PINOUT, Blueprint 5.2).
ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 N16R8 plugs into J10/J11. Do not use GPIO19/20 (USB), 33-37 (octal PSRAM).
LISTEN-ONLY IN SILICON: U3 pin 8 (S) is tied to 3V3 = Silent mode. No jumper, no GPIO can undo it.
JP2 OPEN in a vehicle (bus already 60 R). Measure OBD 6-14 with ignition off before connecting.
MODEM (FLEET only). A7670 UART is 1.8 V: Q3/Q4 shift it. Match J6 to the actual A7670C board before ordering.
